Autumn, typical and bright
The weekend team are ready
Travel alert for companion pets

Staff and travelers should move fast on checks, because the weekend rush is already building at Aurelia Skyways. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping guidance short and clear for every pet in transit, with quick checks on carriers, comfort items, and boarding notes. <<FACT F042>> Please keep paperwork tidy, watch for last-minute changes, and send any concern to the welcome team without delay.

Brightwater departures need extra attention, especially when families arrive with nervous pets and tight connections. <<FACT F044>> Share the right route, confirm each handoff, and keep the tone calm so the animals settle sooner. If Phoebe or any other traveler seems unsettled, escalate at once and keep the line moving. Every careful step helps the cabin team protect comfort and reduce strain on the busiest flights.
